19640.overview:
Like Mega Man Network Transmission, Rockman EXE WS is a side-scrolling, platform-based video game. The gameplay mainly consisted of shooting enemies and jumping through obstacles and platforms.

As the game begin, players are given mission briefing through cutscenes. In the cutscenes there will be conversations between MegaMan and other character, which will explain players about the background of the mission.

After the briefing, players are brought to a screen that shows a list of chips[jargon] the players have gained while playing and four boxes. By selecting a chip from the list, players choose which of the four boxes the chip will go into.

Once chips are selected and the stage begins, players may use the chips by pressing the Y buttons on the console. Unlike the Mega Man Battle Network games, some chips can be used multiple times, or replace the Mega Buster attack (such as Wide Sword. Chips can be found lying in stage or by defeating enemies.

As players battle through the level, the stage splits into two paths. Both paths lead to a different boss, which will be fought depending on player's completion percentage.

19798.overview: Mr. Driller's world has been covered with mysterious colored blocks. Armed with only a mighty drill, you'll have to dig your way down to safety before his air supply runs out! It will take quick thinking and sharp reflexes to get the job done. Can you handle the challenge?

27738.overview: This remake of SaGa features several changes compared to the original. The graphics have been updated to 16-bit level, with new sprites and artwork drawn by Toshiyuki Itahana. New animated sequences have been added to the game as well as an intro sequence. Other new features include the ability to see what a monster would change to if they eat a new meat ahead of time, a bestiary, and the ability to re-target enemies when a previous target is slain by another character. There's even an option to play a straight port of the original Game Boy version as well.

27739.overview: Cursed jewels, the party, and murder. And in the middle of it all, our shrank detective, Kudou Shinichi, who now goes by the name of Conan Edogawa. The player gathers clues by listening to other characters, gathering key words, and most importantly, deducing the truth behind the mystery. The game can be linked with the previously released Meitantei Conan titles for WonderSwan which will effectively alter the story and add a branching path. Notebook with data is compatible with the one from previous works can also be imported.

27740.overview: This is a visual novel game and a side story to the original "Memories Off".

27741.overview:
Mikeneko Holmes: Ghost Panic is a mystery game based on popular Mikeneko Holmes novels by Akagawa Jirō, a Japanese mystery novel writer. The protagonist in this mystery story is none other than Holmes, the cat, not Sherlock, who got involved in a murder incident in an old castle somewhere in southern part of Germany, which is nowadays used as a sightseeing hotel. Ancient legends about witches, demons and strange phenomena are well known in the area, which adds a touch of supernatural to be feared of, if any of it true.

This game is made to play as a sound comic, meaning the artwork is made as an interactive comic book which progresses the story, yet allowing the player to enter choices which will take the story in a different direction and lead to one of several different endings.

27749.overview:
Lan, Chaud, Dex and other characters from the Mega Man Battle Network Universe prepare to duke it out in the Battle Chip GP! Take control of your favorite character and face off against many opponents as you make your way to the head of the GP to reach the ultimate prize, an incredibly rare battle chip!

Gameplay is based around the Mega Man Battle Network series of games, in that players purchase and use various battle chips to combat their opponents. However, unlike the main games, players do not have direct control over their Net Navi. Instead, players pre-select their battle chips, and one of these chips are used in the battle against the opponent. Once selected, the game automatically plays out the battle.
